intersection_validation.note: crossings = triangle pairs touching the branch that intersect and share no vertex (stricter than the quad audit, which ignores triangles of vertex-adjacent quads)

order_invariance_mismatched_quads.note: steps 1-4 (geometry-only) under cyclic shifts / reversed winding of every quad; step 5 visits quads in the frozen index order

normals_tangents.normals: smooth angle-weighted vertex normals on the baked triangles (Blender corner normals; no sharp edges / one smoothing group)
normals_tangents.tangents: MikkTSpace (Blender calc_tangents) on a production-like Smart UV Project unwrap (66 deg islands; the final production UV is outside this gate); spread / sign measured among the loops of a vertex that share one UV (seams excluded)

mirroring.cuff: per-side canonical transitions (Fenn / Vael cuff canon): not a mirror pair

lod.rule: LOD-HV1: Decimate collapse, vertex-group weight 0 on cuff + transition + one ring (protected root junction), 0.35 on the lobe zone (auricle sheet below 30 % of the ear height), 1 elsewhere
